Full Automation

Every cabinet. Fully automated.

No matter which size you choose, every VTCFaRM grow cabinet includes the same 10-point automation system. Set your parameters once and let the cabinet handle the rest.

01
Temperature
Precision climate control with heating and cooling for optimal grow environment 24/7.
02
EC
Automatic electrical conductivity monitoring and dosing for nutrient strength.
03
pH
Continuous pH measurement with auto-correction to maintain ideal nutrient uptake.
04
CO₂
CO₂ enrichment system to boost photosynthesis and accelerate plant growth rates.
05
UV-C
UV-C sterilisation of water and air to prevent pathogens and keep the system clean.
06
Water Oxygenation
Dissolved oxygen management ensures roots receive optimal oxygen at all times.
07
Particulate Filtration
HEPA-grade air filtration removes dust, spores, and airborne contaminants.
08
Auto Top-Up
Automatic water level top-up from reservoir to maintain consistent nutrient volume.
09
LED Scheduling
Programmable LED light cycles with dimming for veg, bloom, and propagation stages.
10
Digital Display
Real-time monitoring panel showing all parameters, alerts, and system status.

Applications

Built for every grower

From restaurant kitchens to research labs to small commercial farms — VTCFaRM grow cabinets adapt to any growing environment.

Application 01
Restaurants
Grow fresh herbs, microgreens, and salad greens on-site. Compact cabinets fit in kitchen corners and back rooms. Harvest daily, zero food miles.
Application 02
Research
Precision-controlled environments for plant science, phenotyping, and cultivar trials. Full data logging and reproducible conditions every cycle.
Application 03
Small Commercial Farms
Stack multiple cabinets for scalable commercial production. Start with one, add more as demand grows. Factory-direct value keeps ROI fast.
Need a Custom Size?
We build grow cabinets to any width, depth, and height. Whether you need a cabinet to fit a specific alcove, a particular tier count, or a custom plant capacity — we can build it. Tell us your space and we'll design the cabinet.
